title: Credential operations
description: Manage OpenAI login details, inspect tokens and re-login after authentication failures.
firstLoginHint: Log in with email, password and the long-lived TOTP secret. Successful imports save the account and enroll it in credential operations. Leave TOTP empty if 2FA is disabled.
totpHint: Use the authenticator setup secret, not a six-digit code. Optional when 2FA is disabled.
batchPlaceholder:
email----password----TOTP secret
JSON arrays are also supported
batchHint: Up to 100 accounts. Supports delimited text, CSV and JSON. Use JSON when a password contains delimiters or newlines.
queueFailed: Could not submit this task. Retry while this page retains the unsubmitted login details.
pollFailed: Progress is temporarily unavailable. Retrying; you can also check task history.
retryFailed: Retry was not submitted. Refresh the task status and try again.
cancelFailed: Cancellation failed. Refresh the status and retry.
durableHint: The server saved these tasks. They continue after this window closes.
encryptionRequired: Enable encryption before saving login details
encryptionHint: A dedicated key is stored in the server’s persistent directory. Back it up with the database; existing keys are never replaced.
encryptionFailed: Cannot initialize or read encryption. Check directory permissions or restore the original missing key.
remoteHint: Session Studio receives the email, password and TOTP secret and uses its own egress. Failures never switch engines automatically.
fixedEgressHint: Local login uses the selected egress and respects fixed account bindings. An unavailable binding pauses execution.
configLoadFailed: Cannot load login configuration. Close and retry.
configSaveFailed: Saving or queueing failed. Check configuration and revision, then retry.
search: Search accounts, emails, IDs or status
batchPartial: Could not queue {{count}} accounts. Check status before retrying.
emptyHint: Choose an existing OAuth account or import an account using 2FA login.
noTasks: No login or recovery tasks yet
removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from inspection? The account and saved login configuration are retained.
rulesHint: Only confirmed authentication failures increment the counter. Network, proxy, 429 and temporary upstream errors do not trigger re-login. Saving reschedules inspections.
studioHeaders: Session Studio authentication headers (JSON; blank keeps saved values)
headersInvalid: Headers must be a JSON object with string values.
rotationHint: Verify the current account before changing its binding. Encrypted old and candidate credentials remain available for recovery. Existing sessions are not signed out.
rotationConfirm: Change 2FA for {{name}}? On success the old secret stops working, and automatic re-login uses the new one.
rotationLoadFailed: Cannot read rotation status. Refresh later.
rotationFailed: Task was not submitted. Check the Worker, account configuration and recovery state.
uncertainHint: The upstream outcome is uncertain. Verify the candidate or original secret before changing 2FA again. Recovery credentials can be exported.
exportFailed: Cannot export credentials. Check administrator access and the encryption key.
useJSON: The password contains a separator or newline. Use JSON to preserve it.

importErrors.format: Invalid format on row {{row}}. Check fields or use JSON.
importErrors.password: Missing or oversized password on row {{row}}.
importErrors.totp: Row {{row}} requires a long-lived TOTP secret, not a one-time code.
importErrors.duplicate: Duplicate email on row {{row}}. Merge entries before submitting.
importErrors.limit: Submit 1–100 accounts and no more than 256 KB of input.

poolLoadFailed: Cannot read the managed node pool. Retry.
poolHint: Each login leases an independent Mihomo process and fixed node. Import a Clash proxies YAML/JSON document; credentials remain encrypted. Existing configuration is kept when the node field is blank.
engineLoadFailed: Cannot load the global login engine. Reopen the form before submitting.
configReloadFailed: The task was queued, but its saved configuration could not be refreshed. Reload configuration before editing.
capabilitiesUnknown: Capabilities not reported; check or upgrade the Worker
